verdict.rationale: There is a public GitHub repository (BerriAI/litellm), and the product is self-hostable via the litellm/litellm Docker image, which suggests the source is readable. No item states the license or confirms it is an open-source license. The enterprise docs also mention a commercial license tier, which leaves open whether all code is open. Missing for 10: explicit open-source license identification (e.g. MIT or Apache) and clarity on which components are under the enterprise license.
